labeling: executed_by_candidate = authored and run by the admitted candidate model inside the pm_execution isolated sandbox (stdlib only, no network). proposed_unexecuted = design-time checks with pass criteria, not run. No evaluator-provided executions exist at this stage.
global_scope_limits: Every executed check is an isolated component check on synthetic inputs; none establishes whole-application behavior.
Execution sandbox for W1-W4: systemd/bubblewrap isolated python, 256 MiB component limit, no network; receipts include code/data/output sha256 and exit codes.

W3 ran against the sandbox's sqlite3 runtime 3.46.1; the docs pins S2/S3 describe the 3.53.4-era release. The version gap is recorded and re-verification is queued (see W3 corrected finding and P-checks).

executed.title: Axis-order swap displacement magnitude
executed.input: point (lat=51.5, lon=-0.12); naive importer reads (lon,lat) tuple as (lat,lon); haversine great-circle distance between intended and swapped readings
executed.expected_justification: Swapping components of a mid-latitude coordinate moves the point to a different hemisphere/continent; distance should be thousands of km, demonstrating that undocumented axis guessing is catastrophic rather than cosmetic.
executed.observed_stdout:
intended point  (lat,lon) = (51.5, -0.12)
swapped reading (lat,lon) = (-0.12, 51.5)
great-circle distance between the two readings: 7490.6 km
scope: pure haversine arithmetic in isolated python; not a projection engine
executed.scope_limits: Pure arithmetic; no PROJ, no file IO, no UI. Supports the design rule that axis order must be explicitly confirmed per import; it does not itself validate any shipped transform.

executed.title: Antimeridian track discontinuity magnitude
executed.input: track endpoints (0, 179.99) and (0, -179.99); naive linear longitude interpolation through lon=0 vs shortest eastward path crossing the antimeridian; 1000-segment haversine sums
executed.expected_justification: Naive interpolation spans ~360 degrees of longitude; the true crossing spans 0.02 degrees (~2.2 km at the equator).
executed.observed_stdout:
track endpoint A (lat,lon)=(0.0, 179.99); endpoint B (lat,lon)=(0.0, -179.99)
naive linear longitude path (through lon=0): 40028.0 km
short antimeridian-crossing path:            2.2 km
ratio naive/wrapped: 17999.0x
scope: arithmetic only; demonstrates discontinuity magnitude, not renderer behavior
executed.scope_limits: Arithmetic only; validates the magnitude of the failure mode addressed by RFC 7946 3.1.9 splitting and by not trusting the renderer (Leaflet #9878), but does not exercise any real split implementation.

executed.title: SQLite R-tree NULL bounding-box behavior (CORRECTED FINDING)
executed.input: in-memory SQLite: obs table (incl. one NULL-coordinate row) + rtree virtual table; attempt to insert the geometry-less row into the rtree with NULL bounds; counts; rtreecheck()
executed.expected_justification: Initial expectation, from the R-tree docs' strict storage-type language (S2), was that a NULL coordinate value would be rejected. The check was designed to make that expectation falsifiable.
executed.observed_stdout:
sqlite3 runtime library version: 3.46.1
rtree virtual table created OK
UNEXPECTED: NULL bbox accepted
rows in rtree index: 2 | rows in observation table: 2
-> geometry-less record stays visible in the table but is absent from the spatial index
rtreecheck('obs_rtree'): ok
scope: stdlib sqlite3 in isolated python; checks documented rtree constraints, not app code
executed.corrected_finding: The observed behavior contradicts the initial expectation: SQLite 3.46.1's rtree accepted a NULL bounding box (the docs' NULL sentence concerns the integer primary key, which auto-generates a rowid, not the coordinate columns). Revised inference: exclusion of geometry-less records from bbox-constrained queries happens implicitly via SQL NULL comparison semantics (NULL bounds never satisfy minx<=x AND maxx>=x), not via a guaranteed documented rejection. Design consequence recorded in proposal section 6.5: FieldLedger enforces geometry-less exclusion through its own has_geometry gate and shows a visible count, rather than delegating correctness to the index.
executed.scope_limits: One sqlite3 build (3.46.1) in the sandbox; docs pins describe the 3.53.4-era site. Behavior must be re-verified on the shipping SQLite before relying on any rtree NULL detail. An isolated component check; not application behavior.

proposed_unexecuted.title: 250k-observation performance run
proposed_unexecuted.pass_criteria: On a 4-core/8GB-class machine: viewport query p95 < 200 ms; indexed attribute search p95 < 300 ms; resident memory < 1.5 GB; export streams without full-table load.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Real PROJ 9.9 transform fixtures
proposed_unexecuted.pass_criteria: Axis-swapped EPSG:4326 input, a national projected CRS, and an unknown vertical datum produce the quarantine/flag behaviors of proposal 6.3/6.4; round-trip inverse check within per-CRS tolerance.
proposed_unexecuted.dependencies: PROJ binding, fixture files with independently computed labels

proposed_unexecuted.title: Export audit round-trip
proposed_unexecuted.pass_criteria: Export 10k rows (incl. antimeridian tracks and null-geometry records) to GeoJSON/GeoPackage, reimport, compare canonical coordinates: zero silent differences; audit report row counts match canonical.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Crash-recovery kill tests
proposed_unexecuted.pass_criteria: kill -9 during import and during merge; on reopen, staging batches are distinguishable from committed records and offer resume/inspect/discard per proposal 7.5; no partial batch ever appears committed.

proposed_unexecuted.title: proj.db pinning / stale-transform detection
proposed_unexecuted.pass_criteria: After a PROJ upgrade, previously transformed records are flagged transform_stale (via version+proj.db hash mismatch) and recompute produces a diff report; no unflagged divergence.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Merge matrix
proposed_unexecuted.pass_criteria: both-edit, edit-vs-delete, duplicate-source-id, geometry-diverged, both-insert-identical classes classify exactly as proposal 7.3 across multi-generation revision histories; unresolved conflicts persist and export flagged.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Relocation and re-import behavior
proposed_unexecuted.pass_criteria: Moving the bundle directory leaves all media resolvable (content addressing); re-importing an identical source is a no-op; a changed source creates a new batch with per-record diffs.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Fixture-label integrity (anti turf-#737 regression)
proposed_unexecuted.pass_criteria: Every standard-derived fixture carries a label computed independently (winding via signed area, axis order via WKT2 axes); a deliberately mislabeled fixture fails CI.

proposed_unexecuted.title: SQLite NULL-bbox behavior re-verification on shipping version
proposed_unexecuted.pass_criteria: Repeat W3 on the shipped SQLite (docs era 3.53.4) and record whether NULL-bbox acceptance matches the 3.46.1 observation; adjust schema gate if behavior differs.
